items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: Oh, and I was interested before, when you said he was older than you, Mr. O'Reilly.

ctx.x: But Wine and Grind was something about mama's... They named it different up there, I don't know what you call it.

Oh, I was wondering about Mutt. Was Mutt ever in the Army? Did he go in the Army, do you think? No, I don't think so. Oh, and I was interested before, when you said he was older than you, Mr. O'Reilly. Yeah. What was...
I think he missed, he just skipped it.
